title: SIX CLUBS WANT HIM. FEYENOORD REPORTEDLY TURNED DOWN £35M
description:
Newcastle may have missed a £33m chance this summer. Now it's a six-club race.

Anis Hadj Moussa is 24, Algerian, and has eight goals in 15 games this season. Last year he managed 14 goals and seven assists. So when Feyenoord reportedly rejected £35m, it didn't look like a bluff.

Newcastle are one of the six clubs chasing him. Add Sunderland, Brighton, Dortmund, Porto and Sporting and you get six clubs, one winger and one very busy phone.

Is £35m too much for a winger with eight goals in 15, or would you pay it? Pick your side below.
